tagline.en: Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer — a behavior-generation policy that tokenizes actions to model multi-modal behavior for imitation learning.
tagline.zh: Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer——一种把动作离散化的行为生成策略,为模仿学习建模多模态行为。

en: VQ-BeT (Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer) is a behavior-generation policy for imitation learning. It uses vector quantization to turn continuous actions into discrete tokens, then a transformer predicts those tokens — an approach that captures the multi-modal, many-valid-ways nature of human demonstrations.
This makes it well suited to learning policies from demonstration data across manipulation and control tasks, where a plain regression policy would blur distinct behaviors together.

In WorldFoundry, VQ-BeT runs through an in-tree action runtime adapter against the concrete VQ-BeT policy. You bring a trained checkpoint; the runtime reports if the checkpoint is missing so you can stage it.
zh: VQ-BeT(Vector-Quantized Behavior Transformer)是一种用于模仿学习的行为生成策略。它用向量量化把连续动作转成离散 token,再由 transformer 预测这些 token——这种方式能刻画人类示范中多模态、多种合理做法并存的特性。
因此它很适合在操作与控制任务上从示范数据学习策略,而普通回归式策略往往会把不同行为混为一谈。
在 WorldFoundry 中,VQ-BeT 通过内置动作运行时适配器,对接具体的 VQ-BeT 策略运行。你需要带上训练好的 checkpoint;若缺失,运行时会提示,便于你准备。

whenToUse.en: Pick VQ-BeT for imitation learning where demonstrations are multi-modal — many valid actions per state — and you want a policy that models that diversity rather than averaging it away.
whenToUse.zh: 当示范是多模态的——每个状态有多种合理动作——而你希望策略去建模这种多样性而非将其平均掉时,适合选择 VQ-BeT 做模仿学习。

notFor.en: It is a policy algorithm rather than a pretrained robot skill; you supply a trained checkpoint and the task setup before it can roll out.
notFor.zh: 它是策略算法而非预训练的机器人技能;需要你提供训练好的 checkpoint 与任务设置,它才能执行 rollout。
